note: ACI reports that PATN's 2026 work plan and budget of 21.872 billion FCFA, adopted on 26 February 2026, supports SIFEC among other state systems. The parent may want the content all the same: a World Bank-financed project's annual costed work plan names SIFEC as a system of the Interior ministry.
